map.区间宽度与 √n 成反比，样本量翻 4 倍区间才缩窄一半。样本很小（如 n<30: Interval width is inversely proportional to √n, so the sample size must quadruple to halve the interval. With very small samples (such as n<30) or proportions near 0 or 1, the normal approximation fails and you should use an exact method (such as Clopper-Pearson) or the t distribution; the interval then tends to be wide, so avoid drawing strong conclusions from it.

map.标准差（样本 s 或已知总体 σ）: Standard deviation (sample s or known population σ)
map.置信区间 CI = x̄ ± 临界值 × 标准差÷√n；t 分布使用样本标准差: Confidence interval CI = x̄ ± critical value × standard deviation÷√n. The t distribution uses the sample standard deviation s (df n−1); the z distribution uses the known population standard deviation σ, or s as a large-sample approximation. Auto uses t for n < 30 and the z approximation otherwise. For df > 120, t is approximated by z; otherwise table values are linearly interpolated by df. Sample size n must be an integer ≥ 1 and standard deviation > 0; t requires n ≥ 2. For n = 1, enter a known population standard deviation and select z manually.
map.💡 总体标准差 σ 已知时可输入 σ 并选 z；σ 未知时输入样本标准差 s，使: 💡 If population standard deviation σ is known, enter σ and select z; otherwise enter sample standard deviation s and use the t distribution (df=n-1).
map.自动模式在 n≥30 时用 z 近似；小样本 t 区间假设总体近似正态。: Auto uses the z approximation for n≥30; a small-sample t interval assumes an approximately normal population.
map.(z 分布；大样本时可用 s 近似 σ): (z distribution; s may approximate σ for large samples)
map.置信区间 CI = x̄ ± 临界值 × 标准差÷√n；t 分布使用样本标准差: Confidence interval CI = x̄ ± critical value × standard deviation ÷ √n. The t distribution uses the sample standard deviation s (degrees of freedom n−1); the z distribution should use the known population standard deviation σ. Auto mode follows the standard-deviation source: use z when the population σ is known, and t when only the sample s is available (large samples may also use t; n≥30 alone no longer switches to z). If σ is unknown but z is selected manually, the result is an approximate interval using s for σ and is labeled as approximate. For df >120 the t critical value is approximated by z; otherwise it is linearly interpolated between the nearest table degrees of freedom. The sample size n must be an integer ≥1 and the standard deviation must be >0; the t distribution requires n ≥2. With n = 1 you must supply a known population σ and use z, or set the source to the population σ.
map.样本标准差 s（总体 σ 未知）: Sample standard deviation s (population σ unknown)
map.自动（σ 已知→z；σ 未知→t）: Auto (σ known → z; σ unknown → t)
map.自动模式依据「标准差来源」选择：总体 σ 已知用 z，σ 未知用 t（大样本也用: Auto mode follows the standard-deviation source: use z when the population σ is known, and t when σ is unknown (large samples included). Selecting z manually with unknown σ produces an approximate label. The t interval assumes an approximately normal population.
map.总体标准差 σ 已知时可输入 σ 并选 z；σ 未知时输入样本标准差 s，使用: When the population standard deviation σ is known, enter σ and choose z; when σ is unknown, enter the sample standard deviation s and use the t distribution (degrees of freedom df=n-1).
